name: aureol-exec-productivity
description: An executive's daily operating routines, run by Claude in Cowork: a guided install that ends on your first brief, a Super Context your assistant starts every session from (priorities, live topics, people, decisions), a daily brief at 06:50, a priority inbox across mail and chat at midday and late afternoon, and a Friday review that finds the asks a connection would have answered. Reads your mail, calendar, chat, documents and meetings. Sends nothing, deletes nothing.
